name: Croatia: Part II package and CTIS upload check
applies_to: the Croatia package as a whole (plan-level checklist step)

items.check: K1 recruitment and informed-consent procedure present, on EudraLex template v2.0, with the Croatia-specific parts and a section for every population pathway in the plan.
K2 recruitment material present for every advertisement, invitation, social-media item, poster, telephone script, letter or other material.

One unified L1 Informirani pristanak per population, and every document set in population_sets whose trigger is true (HR-L1-POPULATION, HR-L1-MINORS, HR-L1-CAPACITY, HR-L1-EMERGENCY, HR-L1-PREGNANCY, HR-L1-SECONDARY); every enrolled age band and decision-maker has a document pathway.
Croatian versions of questionnaires, rating scales, diaries, instructions and cards; English original plus Croatian translation for non-validated instruments.
For every Croatian site: M1 CV (HALMED format), GCP training certificate, M2 declaration of interest and N1 site suitability form.
Mentor documentation for each investigator concerned.
Hospitalisation agreement for each non-hospital site concerned.
O1 insurance policy, certificate and policy terms present (or written confirmation of acceptable interim evidence).
P1 compensation form and the funding description (HR-P-FUNDING) present.
A signed sponsor–site agreement exists for each site before it starts; uploaded where the procedure requires it.
GDPR compliance statement completed in the CTIS Form section; Part II R1 only if required.
S1 biological-samples form present.
Cover letter in Croatian (Part I/Form level; listed here because the Croatia guides require it).
Every participant- or representative-facing document is in Croatian, professionally translated and proofread.
Forms answered by TrialAgents are in Croatian; other documents in Croatian or English.
Blank participant documents contain no signatures or personal data.

Signed and dated at submission where Croatia requires it: M1 CV, GCP certificate, M2 DoI, N1 (authorised site representative), mentor statement, hospitalisation agreement, insurance policy (insurer and policyholder). No signature on K1 (unless the template's declaration requires it), K2, L documents, P1 and S1.
Document names, versions, dates, populations and sites are consistent across the dossier.
Each Croatian site, its principal investigator and planned participant numbers are the same in CTIS, M1, M2, N1, the insurance policy and the site agreement.

Compensation, maximum net expense amounts in euros and the statement that the sponsor bears all protocol-related costs are identical in P1, HR-P-FUNDING, the site agreements and every participant document.
Insurance wording in the participant documents matches the policy.

Data flows, recipients, transfers and retention identical in the GDPR statement, the participant documents and the protocol; no clause contacting outside healthcare professionals for health information.
Sample types, storage, transfers and retention identical in S1, the protocol and the participant documents; optional uses separated.
Consent pathways in K1 match the L1 sets in the package.
Documents adapted from the reference package contain the Croatian national additions and no leftovers from the reference country.
items.applies_when: Croatia is not the reference package

items.check: Correct B–S section prefix and CTIS placeholder for each document; GDPR statement in the Form section.
Unique, self-explanatory title of at most 100 characters: <section code>_<document type>_<subtype>_<country>_<language>_<special attribute>.
Population, site, country, language and age band clear in participant-document filenames.
Version and date entered in CTIS metadata, not in the title.
Personal names only where disclosure permits (principal investigator in M1/M2).
Clean, tracked-change, redacted or public and split-file variants clearly distinguished.
Uploaded filename base contains none of ( ) / , . ; | [ ] (the period before the extension is fine).
Article 11 workaround: every mandatory Part II placeholder holds the official placeholder PDF titled Part_II_placeholder_document_Article_11_workaround.
items.applies_when: Croatia receives Part I only under Article 11

items.check: For each document, publication status checked against the current Annex I publication tables (revised CTIS transparency rules applicable from 18 June 2024; ACT EU guidance v2.2, 30 April 2026).
Publishable documents: personal data and CCI identified separately; public version redacts only qualifying material.
Public and assessment versions differ only by the intended redactions; each in the correct CTIS slot.
No personal data or CCI in public structured fields.
No drafting instruction remains in any document (see content/conventions/template-instructions.md).
Every final PDF opened and checked (page order, Croatian diacritics, selectable text, no comments, tracked changes or hidden content).
Every document approved by the owner in TrialAgents, or the user has explicitly chosen to export unapproved versions.
